description: Na₅GeP₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are five inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to one P²⁻ and three P³⁻ atoms to form NaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent GeP₄ tetrahedra, corners with five NaP₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one GeP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids. The Na-P bond length is 2.88 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.84-2.86 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to two equivalent P²⁻ and two P³⁻ atoms to form NaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent GeP₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two NaP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.89 Å) and one longer (3.00 Å) Na-P bond length. There is one shorter (2.88 Å) and one longer (2.91 Å) Na-P bond length. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent P²⁻ and three P³⁻ atoms. There is one shorter (3.00 Å) and one longer (3.05 Å) Na-P bond length. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.39 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to two equivalent P²⁻ and three P³⁻ atoms to form distorted NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent GeP₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaP₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent GeP₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaP₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaP₅ trigonal bipyramid. There is one shorter (3.01 Å) and one longer (3.20 Å) Na-P bond length. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.26 Å. In the fifth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one P²⁻ and three P³⁻ atoms. The Na-P bond length is 2.99 Å. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.91-3.28 Å. Ge³⁺ is bonded to one P²⁻ and three P³⁻ atoms to form GeP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaP₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one GeP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaP₅ trigonal bipyramids. The Ge-P bond length is 2.35 Å. There are a spread of Ge-P bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.43 Å. P²⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to eight Na¹⁺ and one Ge³⁺ atom. There are two inequivalent P³⁻ sites. In the first P³⁻ site, P³⁻ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na¹⁺ and one Ge³⁺ atom. In the second P³⁻ site, P³⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to seven Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ge³⁺ atoms.
